svg.title: Falcon Lens system architecture
svg.desc: A check enters from the PWA, the Chrome extension or a police app through the Caddy gateway to the API. The API puts a job on a Redis stream. The worker runs the tiers T0 to T3 with an exit after each tier, and a deterministic arbiter sets the verdict, which returns to the user over SSE. The sandbox sits on an isolated network behind the egress proxy. A model router sends LLM calls to a local Ollama model in sovereign mode or to the Anthropic API in cloud mode. The Sentinel consumes verdict events. Postgres with pgvector and Redis hold the data, and an observability stack collects metrics, logs and traces.

g.text: One check end to end: request in, tiered cascade, deterministic verdict back over SSE. Target design; build status is in the README.
